title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E14 — New House Brunch
Ree Drummond is hosting a Tex-Mex brunch in her new home and serving a make-ahead spread with spicy Breakfast Enchiladas, a Churro French Toast Bake with Chocolate Butter, and a marvelous Mango Salad that's so delicious!

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E09 — Ree's New Garden
Ree Drummond is adding her fresh garden ingredients to recipes, starting with moist chocolate zucchini muffins; Ree also makes easy best ever pesto, a tomato sandwich, a green goddess chopped salad and spicy herb garden butter.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S14 E10 — Quick and Easy Fall Favorites
Chicken chili; seasonal fall stir-fry; cheesy chicken pasta with broccoli and bacon; caramel apple bomb pie; pear bubbly.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S22 E10 — Fall Fan Favorites
New twists on viewers' fall favorites include Sunny Anderson's mini meatloaves Cheat Sheet and Geoffrey Zakarian's pumpkin, bacon and caramelized onion quiche; cookbook author Samantha Seneviratne bakes a maple cream pie.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E06 — Handheld Hits
The Kitchen is serving up handheld bites perfect for a tailgate or outdoor party; Spiked Lemon Iced Tea, Deviled Chicken Wings, Bacon Bow Tie Crackers and Herb Dip and Carmelitas; guest Tony Shalhoub shares his recipe for Spinach Fatayer.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E04 — Up to No Good
Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized "Harry Potter" artifacts that reveal something from within; special guest Afshan Azad joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E05 — Magical Beasts, Beings, and Creatures
James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that bring a Harry Potter creature to life, along with a bold smoky or spicy tasting element; special guest Warwick Davis joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E06 — The Goblet of Fire
For the finale in the Great Hall, James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire; guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray join Carla Hall to award the Wizards of Baking trophy.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E04 — The Great 8 Teams Sleigh
The randomizer is dialed to extra naughty as the victorious Great Eight teams return for the second round; only two teams will sleigh their matchups and move one step closer to the title, the trophy, $100,000, and major charity cash.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E05 — Jingle All the Way to the Finals
The remaining Great Eight teams fight for their spot in the Final Four; with the championship within reach, the stakes have never been higher; who can keep jingling all the way to the finale?

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S01 E06 — A Christmas Champion Is Crowned
Guy Fieri welcomes the final four culinary teams back to the festive battlefield for two jolly head-to-heads; only one team can walk away with the trophy, the glory, big bucks for charity and a sleigh-load of $100,000!

title: Worst Cooks in America
description:
S30 E02 — Reality Check: Hollywood's Next Culinary Star
Chefs Jeff and Tiffany teach the teams a soup and sandwich combo before tackling the main dish challenge of eggplant Parmesan and handmade pasta; the bottom two recruits must battle it out in a blind elimination appetizer cook-off.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S11 E10 — First Time for Everything
Falafel with chipotle tahini dip piled into a pita; chicken and waffles with a decadent maple syrup and bourbon sauce; upside-down tarte Tatin with caramel, apples, and a store-bought pastry shortcut.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S16 E02 — All In A Morning's Work
Ree Drummond fixes up a warming lunch; chunky beef chili; a cowboy favorite with two kinds of beef; cheesy quesadilla; individual caramel cakes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E11 — Breakfast Bakes 4 Ways
Ree rises and shines with four delicious breakfast bakes; she starts with maple pancake cake, puts a savory spin on breakfast monkey bread, fills the oven with a puff pastry quiche and ends with a sausage and pepper grits bake.

title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
description: The Kitchen makes delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E11 — Tastes Like Home
The hosts are sharing nostalgic bites from their hometowns, like baked steak and gravy, New England clam dip and an authentic Chicago-style pizza pillow puff; chocolate pudding and cream roll cake is inspired by a well-loved sweet treat.

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E07 — Bigs & Littles
For each team, Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the older sibling to make one big dessert and the younger sibling to make a dozen little desserts; the teammates can talk to each other, but they can't work on each other's desserts!

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E08 — Hat Tricks
Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown task the final sibling teams with creating "Cat in the Hat" helper desserts; they must craft a large, non-cake dessert featuring a joyful animal character.

title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
description:
S01 E09 — Cake to Move You
For the final challenge, Goldman and Kardea Brown ask the sibling teams to create a delicious cake that gives a stunning animated illusion as the cake spins around; the winning team walks away with $25,000 and the title of Next Gen Baking Champions.

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
Kids Baking Championship: Frosting the Snowman
Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown challenge four kid bakers to bake up handmade gifts for the underappreciated residents of the North Pole; the kid who bakes the best gift will go home with a $10,000 prize package of seasonal baking tools.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E04 — Island Holiday Party
To celebrate the release of Disney's Moana 2, host Jeff Mauro tasks the six remaining teams with imagining what a holiday party on the island of Motunui would look like; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown decide which team is eliminated.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E05 — Mrs. Claus' Night Out
Host Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a scene capturing what it looks like when Mrs. Claus has a night out on the town and the cookie artists are in the spotlight; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown eliminate one more team.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E06 — Santa's Stand-In
Host Jeff Mauro asks the teams to imagine what holiday hijinks unfold when another holiday icon fills in for Santa on Christmas Eve; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown determine which three teams move forward.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E07 — Woodland Winter Games
Host Jeff Mauro challenges the three remaining teams to create a scene that features woodland animals going for gold in an Olympic event; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown determine which two teams head to the finale.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S06 E08 — Pet, Meet Christmas Tree
For the final challenge, Jeff Mauro asks the two teams to imagine the hilarity that ensues when a pet takes on the family Christmas tree; judges Shinmin Li and Kardea Brown decide who will be crowned champion and take home the prize of $25,000.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package, and one baker from the losing team is eliminated.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E15 — Love Is Sweet
Love is in the air as actress Kaley Cuoco and Scott Conant team up with pastry chefs and spouses, Melissa and Sean McGaughey, for a bittersweet battle against Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E11 — Lights! Camera! Distraction!
Comedian and movie podcaster Paul Scheer and Katie Lee Biegel want to call cut on Bobby Flay and get chefs Rashida Holmes and Dave White their close-up.

Duff Goldman and Amanda Freitag attempt to bake up a win against Bobby.

Chef Eddie Jackson and NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport huddle up with chefs Nick Shipp and Natalie Blake as they try to get Bobby Flay to fumble.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S34 E09 — What a Dump-ling!
Chefs Anne Burrell and Eddie Jackson bring the noise as chefs Jessica Yarr and Matthew Zafrir bring the flavor to dump Bobby Flay in a pierogi battle.

title: Next Baking Master: Paris
description:
S01 E06 — Break an Egg
Stephanie Boswell and Ludo Lefebvre challenge the bakers with a dish that demands perfection, the soufflé.

title: Next Baking Master: Paris
description:
S01 E07 — Like a Fine Wine and Cheese
Stephanie Boswell and Ludo Lefebvre send the final four to a fromagerie where they shop for a dessert spotlighting cheese.

title: Next Baking Master: Paris
description:
S01 E08 — Let Them Eat Cake
Stephanie Boswell and Ludo Lefebvre whisk the finalists away to Ladurée, where they sample Julien Alvarez's macarons.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E08 — Totally Nuts Day
Fieri cranks up the chaos as the returning champ faces off against chefs Hanna Haar and Gustavo Romero in a nut-fueled challenge; standing between them and victory are judges Lee Anne Wong and Eric Greenspan, who are ready to scrutinize every bite.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E09 — Heat Day
Guy Fieri is turning up the heat in Flavortown as the returning winner defends their title against Franklin Becker and Allison Fasano; the chefs must ignite the taste buds of judges Dale Talde and Claudette Zepeda with their spiciest dishes.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E10 — Game Day
Guy Fieri kicks off Game Day as the reigning champ faces Torrence Chef T Gregoire and Joe Flamm in tackling fan-favorite flavors; judges Marcel Vigneron and Marcus Samuelsson are calling the plays and only one chef can win up to $20,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E11 — Fry Day
Fieri has declared it Fry Day, and the returning champion takes on Jacob Town and Taylor Frankel in an epic battle for golden brown and delicious domination; Judges Mei Lin and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef takes home the gold and up to $20,000.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E01 — Battle Italiano: Emilia-Romagna
Four chefs get to the heart of Italian cuisine with ingredients from the robust Emilia-Romagna region; a surprise challenges the chefs in the appetizer round, while the entrée round ends with very different takes on a veal and mushroom dish.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E02 — Battle Italiano: Veneto
The chefs showcase what they know about making amazing Venetian dishes; a strikingly strange ingredient in the first basket threatens to throw them off their game, while using polenta to best effect in a half-hour entrée round is a tremendous task.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E03 — Battle Italiano: Puglia
Italy's olive oil capital inspires four chefs as they create coastal cuisine from Puglia; in the appetizer round, a chef's mistake causes a big stink in the kitchen, and a cactus creates a prickly situation in the dessert round.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E04 — Battle Italiano: Tuscany
Four chefs focus on the fresh and humble food of Tuscany; for the appetizer, they must make good choices while dealing with a super-lean meat, and they face issues of confidence and competence to make it to the finale.

title: Chopped
description:
S59 E05 — Battle Italiano: Finale
Four winning chefs return for the Battle Italiano finale, where they'll represent their regions; emotions run high in a dramatic entrée round, and unfamiliar ingredients in the dessert basket keep the finalists on their toes.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S37 E08 — Risk It for the Biscuit
Chef Josh Capon and actor and comedian Lil Rel Howery cheer on chefs Declan Horgan and Melvin Boots Johnson in a mighty battle to defeat Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S37 E13 — BFFs vs. Bobby
BFFs Carla Hall and Tiffany Derry are pumped up and rarin' to go as chefs Pam Liberda and Chris Sanchez attempt to Thai one on with Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S40 E05 — Power Couple
Chefs Wolfgang Puck and protégé Antonia Lofaso team up with a chef couple, Fany Gerson and Danny Ortiz de Montellano, to take on Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E02 — Shaken and Stirred
Bobby Flay gets shaken and stirred when Taraji P. Henson and Amanda Freitag try to mix up a defeat with pastry chefs Maurice Shelton and Cristina Vazquez.

S04 E05 — Titans vs. Maneet Chauhan
Chef Maneet Chauhan throws down her gauntlet to win $25,000 against Bobby Flay's Titans; after losing to Maneet twice on Tournament of Champions, Brooke Williamson is ready to defend her home court; chef Charlie Mitchell doles out tough critiques.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E05 — Titans vs. Silvia Barban
Chef Silvia Barban has one thing on her mind, and that's sweet revenge; Brooke Williamson has beaten Silvia in the past, and it's still on her mind! If she can handle the hurdles of Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen, she just may taste it.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S01 E01 — Titans vs. Jonathon Sawyer
Heavy hitting chef Jonathon Sawyer fights for his life against Bobby Flay's Titans; one chef risks it all by making pasta for legendary Italian chef and judge Nancy Silverton.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S14 E13 — Fall Brunch Strikes Back
Sunny Anderson makes Funky Monkey Bread Pudding; Jeff Mauro and Katie Lee share recipes for Pancake Tacos; adding new flavors to amp up oatmeal; Chef Meny Vaknin serves Mediterranean Eggs; Geoffrey Zakarian serves Apple Cider Brunch Punch.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S36 E04 — Weeknight Winners: Kitchen Tools Edition
The Kitchen rethinks kitchen tools to make a week's worth of easy dinners; Katie Lee Biegel makes slow cooker pulled pork tacos, Geoffrey Zakarian whips up a quick pasta amatriciana and Sunny Anderson steams up garlic ginger chicken dumplings.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S38 E11 — Kitchen Rules
The Kitchen is sharing essential rules for culinary success, including how to cook pork, seafood and a classic omelet. Plus, special guests Bryon Gomez and Nini Nguyen from Food Network's Hot List 2025 stop by to share their own cooking rules.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E01 — Titans vs. Alex Stupak
Titan Michael Voltaggio is left speechless when his longtime friend Alex Stupak enters Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen; this culinary rebel is ready to annihilate the Titans and win the glory, but Michelin-star chef Buddha Lo is the judge of that.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E03 — Titans vs. Competition Legend
It's the shock heard round the culinary world as Bobby Flay calls a dear friend to triple threat under false pretenses, and his surprise has the Titans shook; Italian culinary maestro Stefano Secchi holds all the cards.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E05 — Titans vs. Kenny Gilbert
Titan Michael Voltaggio's former mentor Kenny Gilbert is here to claim a spot on the Titans' couch. His Southern-inspired global dishes do impress James Beard Award-winning chef Nina Compton, but are they enough to secure the win?

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E11 — Titans vs Katianna Hong
Chef Katianna Hong works her culinary magic against the Titans.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E03 — Extreme Express Lane
In the most extreme express lane challenge ever, Guy Fieri gives three all-star chefs one hour to make an upscale appetizer, entrée, and dessert using a total of only 12 ingredients! The winner gets to shop Flavortown Market for up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E10 — Firefighters & All-Star Friends
Fieri invites firefighters to partner with all-star chefs for a special team competition; the firefighters and their all-star sous chefs make a 20-minute firehouse breakfast to win $2,500, followed by a complete firehouse dinner to win up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E11 — GGG Callouts
Guy Fieri invites two of GGG's winningest chefs to call out the all-star chefs who played a part in their unexpected loss for a shot at winning $10,000; Laura Fonner takes on judge Aarti Sequeira and Crista Luedtke calls out Stephanie Izard.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S15 E05 — DDD Holiday Showdown
Guy gives the chefs gift boxes containing ingredients they must use in their holiday ham dish; they receive stockings filled with sweets and treats that must be included in their family holiday dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S22 E12 — GGG Holiday Cook-Off
Four charitable chefs compete in a holiday cook-off; Guy hands out gifts of special ingredients that the chefs must feature in their holiday pork dish; he uses a dreidel to give the chefs their budgets for a festive family favorite.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S03 E02 — Pie in the Sky
Ina Garten passes the whipped cream as she recruits chefs Amanda Freitag, Aarti Sequeira and Duff Goldman to serve Bobby Flay a slice of humble pie; in each round, these chefs bake up an ode to everyone's favorite Thanksgiving dessert.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S02 E05 — Feeling Frosted
Sunny Anderson sprinkles holiday cheer with sugar, spice and everything nice; Chefs Stephanie Izard, Damaris Phillips and Duff Goldman challenge Bobby Flay to a baking battle as they whip up some frosted treats in a bid to leave Bobby iced out.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package, and one baker from the losing team is eliminated.
